notes.title: Room 14 has released
notes.content:
Hello 
I have been working on a new game for a month or so now and I am now releasing it.

What comes with Room 14:

- an endless Highschool with spot the difference gameplay
- 7 different shaders  
- 30 anomalies 
-Realistic art style 

About:
You are inside an endless high school but there is a way you can escape. Search in the hallways of the school and find the changes within them to reach Room 14.
If you find anomalies, turn around!
If you think the room is normal continue to the exit.
To get to Room 14.
Room 14 is a small walking simulator inspired by the backrooms and liminal spaces.

[previewyoutube=mi7oC8vTutw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Steam page link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976500/Room_14/

notes.title: I am working on a New Game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009908/a6e459e6af52294f32b50b6ece5510beb56db422.jpg[/img]
Hello 
I have been working on a new game for a while now and I am now showing it off this game is going to be a chapter-based arcade horror game with you being able to replay every level to earn an S rank in all of them.

What comes with chapter 1:

-One level that has a normal and expert difficulty 
-A start for the narrative of the world of ink haven
-Two characters to get introduced into the world "The Strange librarian" and "The doctor"
-A ranking system that will add many hours of replay ability
-A unique art style: everything is hand drawn 
-Full Controller support 
-cheat codes for customization of the map 
-free to play 

About:
A first-person horror maze game. Hiding & standing still is Death. Run or you are DEAD. Trapped in a realm of nightmarish mazes with your only hope of survival is to find all of the pages to the mysterious book and ESCAPE!

This is the first chapter in The Paper Trials. survive the first maze. You are not alone. The doctors in there and they are looking for you. Will you survive?

[previewyoutube=DIHu2RysxC4;full][/previewyoutube]

Steam page link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2548330/The_Paper_Trials/

notes.title: Minor Gameplay Changes Patch
notes.content:
Changes:
1.Fixed grappling hook being used backwards and other changes to grappling. 
2.Rocket jumping height change and stability changed.
3.Settings menu Ui changes.
4.Many weapons accuracy has been changed.
5.Many levels difficulty made easier 

Thanks:
And lastly thank you all who have played the game and for exploring the world of Radiant Cell.
P.S we are leaving early access in the coming month and starting to work on possible DLC for Radiant Cell

Possible Ideas for DLC:
Boss Rush mode
Endless mode 
Story content in the glitched world 
If you guys have any ideas for more content, you'd like to see. 
Leave them here!
